Address library helper performing arbitrary low-level call with value and data.

Caller-controlled address used as transfer sender, owner comparison and unlock identity.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates to internal _transfer with msg.sender.
transferFrom() delegates to internal _transfer using the sender argument.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
_transfer hands off to _tokenTransfer after limits and swap checks.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance crosses the threshold.
_tokenTransfer reaches _takeLiquidity through the transfer variants.
_tokenTransfer reaches _reflectFee through the transfer variants.
Transfer amounts are computed by _getValues before balances are written.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth for half of the tokens.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the remaining ETH.
swapAndLiquify performs the marketing ETH transfer mid-function.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call.
addLiquidity executes the external addLiquidityETH call.
claimTokens performs the ETH transfer to marketingWallet.
clearStuckBalance performs the ETH transfer to an arbitrary wallet.
claimOtherTokens performs the ERC20 transfer of contract balances.
airdrop calls _transfer with fees removed.
airdropArray loops into _transfer through airdropInternal.
deliver uses _getValues to derive the reflection amount.
sendValue performs the low-level ETH call.
_functionCallWithValue performs the arbitrary low-level call.
_takeLiquidity credits _rOwned for the contract address.
excludeFromReward flips the _isExcluded flag for the account.
excludeFromReward snapshots the reflection balance into _tOwned.
lock writes _lockTime from block.timestamp plus the provided duration.
lock stashes the current owner into _previousOwner.
unlock reads _previousOwner to restore ownership.
unlock compares block.timestamp against _lockTime.
msg.sender is the sender of the public transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed.
unlock requires msg.sender to equal _previousOwner.
block.timestamp determines the owner lock duration, making ownership release time-dependent.
unlock authorization depends on block.timestamp exceeding _lockTime.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, providing no real deadline protection.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline.
marketingWallet is the destination of the drained ETH balance.
marketingWallet receives the 80% share during swapAndLiquify.
total supply is produced by constant multiplication arithmetic that feeds all rate math.
maxTxAmount and swap thresholds are derived from supply arithmetic.
reflection mul/div arithmetic determines the token amount swapped for liquidity.
maxTxAmount caps the transfer amount and the swap sizing.
the threshold decides whether swapAndLiquify runs during a transfer.
inSwapAndLiquify guards against recursive swap triggering.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the liquidity block inside _transfer.
canTrade restricts transfers to the owner until trading is enabled.
botWallets blacklist check blocks flagged senders and recipients.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the token-to-ETH swap.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against the sender to avoid circular liquidity events.
Router swap sends ETH to the contract and can re-enter transfer logic before inSwapAndLiquify is cleared.
ETH transfer to marketingWallet occurs mid-swapAndLiquify while balances are still being reconciled.
addLiquidityETH executes externally while the lockTheSwap guard is held, allowing nested transfer entry.
Low-level call in Address.sendValue can re-enter owner-only ETH withdrawal functions.
Arbitrary low-level call with attacker target/calldata can re-enter token claim routines.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value to the router.
walletaddress parameter is the destination of the balance sweep.
time parameter is added to block.timestamp to set the lock.
target parameter determines the arbitrary call destination.
weiValue parameter is attached as the call value.
from local drives the zero-address, blacklist and fee checks in _transfer.
to local drives the zero-address, blacklist and fee checks in _transfer.
half local is the token amount routed into swapTokensForEth.
newBalance local is split between marketing transfer and liquidity.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is an argument of transfer and has no independent security meaning.
amount is an argument of transfer only.
sender is an argument of transferFrom only.
from is a local alias of the validated sender inside _transfer.
to is a local recipient inside _transfer.
amount is the transfer argument consumed by _tokenTransfer.
contractTokenBalance is a transient calculation local to _transfer.
half is a transient split local inside swapAndLiquify.
newBalance is a transient ETH accounting local inside swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount is the sole argument of swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount is a value argument of addLiquidity.
walletaddress is the destination argument of the balance sweep.
recipient is an argument of airdrop.
account is the argument mutated by excludeFromReward.
time is the duration argument of lock.
target is the call target argument of the low-level call helper.
weiValue is the value argument of the low-level call helper.
data is the calldata argument of the low-level call helper.
tAmount is the burned amount argument of deliver.
